_comment: A realistic MCP catalog for the compiler eval: tool names, descriptions and parameters modelled on popular open-source MCP servers. Several tools deliberately look alike across servers (send_email / post_message / send_message, two create_issue, three file searches) — telling them apart is the test.

servers.name: Gmail
servers.description: Read, search, send and organise email in a Gmail mailbox.

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send an email to one or more recipients.

tools.name: search_emails
tools.description: Search emails using Gmail search syntax, e.g. from:alice is:unread.

tools.name: read_email
tools.description: Read the full content of one email by its message id.

tools.name: draft_email
tools.description: Create a draft email without sending it.

tools.name: modify_labels
tools.description: Add or remove labels on an email, e.g. mark as read or archive.

tools.name: delete_email
tools.description: Permanently delete an email.

servers.name: Slack
servers.description: Post and read messages in Slack workspace channels and threads.

tools.name: post_message
tools.description: Post a message to a Slack channel.

tools.name: reply_to_thread
tools.description: Reply in a thread under an existing Slack message.

tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: List the public channels in the workspace.

tools.name: get_channel_history
tools.description: Get recent messages from a Slack channel.

tools.name: add_reaction
tools.description: Add an emoji reaction to a message.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Get a Slack user's profile details.

servers.name: WhatsApp
servers.description: Send and read WhatsApp messages from your personal WhatsApp account.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a WhatsApp text message to a phone number or contact.

recipient.description: Phone number with country code, or contact name

tools.name: list_chats
tools.description: List recent WhatsApp chats.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: Get messages from a WhatsApp chat.

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Search WhatsApp contacts by name or number.

tools.name: send_file
tools.description: Send an image, video or document over WhatsApp.

servers.name: GitHub
servers.description: Work with GitHub repositories: issues, pull requests, code and files.

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Open a new issue in a GitHub repository.

tools.name: list_issues
tools.description: List issues in a GitHub repository, filtered by state or label.

tools.name: create_pull_request
tools.description: Open a pull request from one branch into another.

tools.name: list_pull_requests
tools.description: List pull requests in a repository.

tools.name: get_file_contents
tools.description: Get the contents of a file in a repository.

tools.name: search_code
tools.description: Search code across GitHub repositories.

tools.name: add_issue_comment
tools.description: Comment on an existing issue or pull request.

tools.name: merge_pull_request
tools.description: Merge an open pull request.

servers.name: Jira
servers.description: Track work in Jira: issues, tickets, sprints and projects.

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Create a Jira issue (task, bug or story) in a project.

tools.name: search_issues
tools.description: Search Jira issues with JQL.

tools.name: transition_issue
tools.description: Move a Jira issue to another status, e.g. In Progress or Done.

tools.name: assign_issue
tools.description: Assign a Jira issue to a person.

tools.name: get_sprint
tools.description: Get the active sprint of a Jira board with its issues.

servers.name: Notion
servers.description: Search, read and write pages and databases in a Notion workspace.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Notion pages and databases by title or content.

tools.name: create_page
tools.description: Create a new Notion page under a parent page or database.

tools.name: append_block
tools.description: Append text content to the end of an existing Notion page.

tools.name: query_database
tools.description: Query rows of a Notion database with filters.

tools.name: retrieve_page
tools.description: Get a Notion page's properties and content.

servers.name: Google Drive
servers.description: Find, read and upload files in Google Drive.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search Google Drive files by name or content.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the content of a Google Drive file (Docs exported as text).

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Upload a file to a Google Drive folder.

tools.name: share_file
tools.description: Share a Drive file with someone by email.

servers.name: Google Sheets
servers.description: Read and write data in Google Sheets spreadsheets.

tools.name: read_range
tools.description: Read cell values from a spreadsheet range, e.g. Sheet1!A1:D20.

tools.name: append_rows
tools.description: Append rows of values to the end of a sheet.

tools.name: update_cells
tools.description: Overwrite cell values in a range.

tools.name: create_spreadsheet
tools.description: Create a new spreadsheet.

servers.name: Google Calendar
servers.description: See and schedule events on Google Calendar.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List calendar events between two dates.

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Create a calendar event or meeting and invite attendees.

tools.name: find_free_time
tools.description: Find free time slots across calendars for a meeting.

tools.name: delete_event
tools.description: Cancel and delete a calendar event.

servers.name: HubSpot
servers.description: CRM: contacts, companies and sales deals in HubSpot.

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Search CRM contacts by name, email or company.

tools.name: create_contact
tools.description: Add a new contact (lead) to the CRM.

tools.name: create_deal
tools.description: Create a sales deal in a pipeline stage.

tools.name: update_deal_stage
tools.description: Move a deal to another pipeline stage, e.g. closed won.

tools.name: list_deals
tools.description: List deals, optionally by pipeline stage or owner.

servers.name: Weather
servers.description: Current weather and forecasts for any city.

tools.name: get_current_weather
tools.description: Get the current weather for a city.

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description: Get a multi-day weather forecast for a city.
